channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: How to watch the Winter Paralympics in France
item.description: If you're missing your Winter Olympics fix then don't despair - the Paralympics start on Friday. Here's how to watch if you are in France.

item.title: MAP: How to find the cheapest petrol and diesel in France
item.description: The French finance ministry has promised that the price of fuel will rise by 'only a few cents' as a result of the war in Iran and conflict the wider Gulf area, but some filling stations in France are already hiking prices - here's how to find the cheapest fuel near you.

item.title: French Phrase of the Day: Prendre le melon
item.description: This French expression doesn't always mean you're picking out a melon at the grocery store...

item.title: How to watch the 2026 Rugby Six Nations Championship on French TV
item.description: The 2026 Rugby Six Nations Championship continues - here's how to watch it if you are in France.

item.title: March 8: What's happening in France on International Women’s Day
item.description: Events are planned across France to mark International Women’s Day, on Sunday, March 8th, and raise awareness of gender equality, reproductive rights, and violence and abuse against women - here's how to find out what's on near you.

item.title: No, the Pompidou Centre isn't being turned into migrant housing
item.description: The French cybercrime authorities are investigating after the website of a Paris mayoral election candidate was spoofed, and false claims published that he intended to turn the Pompidou Centre into 'housing for migrants'.

item.title: How long can you drive on a US licence in France?
item.description: Whether you’re coming to France as a tourist or plan to stay for the longer term, will you be able to drive on your US licence?

item.title: OPINION: Why Macron will not 'do a Chirac' over this Gulf war
item.description: As the US launches strikes against Iran, Emmanuel Macron's reaction has been very different to his predecessor Jacques Chirac, who refused to join the British and American invasion of Iraq in 2003 - John Lichfield examines why.

item.title: EES LATEST: The key dates when France will enforce new EU border checks
item.description: The EU's new Entry & Exit System of border control started on October 12th - but a phased introduction means that not everyone travelling to and from France is affected by the new system.

item.title: EXPLAINED: France's new income requirements for citizenship
item.description: Changes to the application of rules around income are making it tougher to become French - here's a look at what the rules say, and what has changed.
